entities.name: E2R
entities.description: A general-purpose data specification centered on Dataset, Entity, Event, and Relation.

entities.name: E2R Core 1.0
entities.description: The minimal interoperable E2R data model.

entities.name: Metadata Extension 1.0.0 — Stable
entities.description: Stable Extension for optional Dataset identity and descriptive metadata.

entities.name: History Extension 1.0.0 — Stable
entities.description: Stable Extension for temporal information on Events.

entities.name: Coordinate Extension 0.1.0 — Draft / Experimental
entities.description: Draft Extension for reusable Entity and Event positions in Dataset-defined Coordinate Spaces.

entities.name: Specification Extension 0.1.0 — Draft
entities.description: Draft Extension for declaring exact Extension specification versions and related lifecycle metadata.

entities.name: Lineage Extension 0.1.0 — Draft / Experimental
entities.description: Draft Extension for direct Dataset ancestry claims using Dataset-ID parent targets.

entities.name: NarrativeLine
entities.description: E2R timeline editor and visualization application.

entities.name: LiaisonScape
entities.description: E2R relationship-oriented exploration and editing application.

entities.name: E2R Validator
entities.description: Validator for E2R Core and selected Extension structures, including Lineage Draft 0.1.0.

entities.name: E2R Hub
entities.description: E2R ecosystem entry-point application; publication of this artifact is future work.

entities.name: E2R Self-Description
entities.description: Informative, experimental machine-readable dogfood Dataset describing the current E2R ecosystem.

events.name: Lineage Draft 0.1.0 created
events.description: The Lineage Extension candidate became an explicit Draft document and payload shape.

events.name: Cross-application opaque round-trip evidence completed
events.description: NarrativeLine and LiaisonScape preserved unsupported Lineage Draft data through representative load, edit, and export workflows.

events.name: Lineage Validator diagnostic design completed
events.description: Structural and local-semantic diagnostic behavior was designed without production Validator changes.

events.name: Validator gained Lineage Draft recognition
events.description: E2R Validator 0.3.0 began recognizing and locally validating Lineage Draft 0.1.0.

metadata.title: E2R Self-Description — Machine-Readable Dogfood
metadata.description: Informative and experimental. Normative authority remains the E2R specification documents and registered specification artifacts.
